value.rationale: The local arrival rule has a sharp sign flip at exactly twice the parent birth index, and its cumulative effect has a distinct macroscopic sign threshold alpha=0.284668..., revealing a nontrivial redistribution of positive and negative dependence that must cancel because total outdegree is fixed. The root case lacks this competition, so the nonroot phase distinction has structural value beyond a routine root-parameter substitution.
